profile.description: Computer Science student at Daffodil International University with a strong foundation in programming, algorithms, software development, mathematics, and AI prompt engineering. Interested in building thoughtful web solutions and evaluating AI-powered digital experiences.

text: I am Md. Arman Hossen, a Computer Science student at Daffodil International University. My academic focus combines Computer Science & Software Engineering as my primary major concentration with Mathematics as my secondary major concentration.

I am building a strong foundation in programming concepts, object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithm design, web development, and mathematical computing. I enjoy applying computational logic and analytical reasoning to understand problems and develop practical solutions.

Alongside software development, I have a strong interest in AI prompt engineering, AI content evaluation, response testing, fact-checking, web research, and bilingual content assessment in English and Bengali.
